title: Makita 18Vx2 Brushless Lawn Mower Kit + Redeem 2x18V 5Ah Batteries - $599 ($0 C&C/in Store) @ Bunnings Warehouse & Sydney Tools
body:
Deal: Makita 18Vx2 Brushless Lawn Mower Kit + Redeem 2x18V 5Ah Batteries - $599 ($0 C&C/in Store) @ Bunnings Warehouse & Sydney Tools

[jabes] Makita Roadshow is currently active at Sydney Tools until the close of business on Saturday (12/09). You will earn $100 in-store credit on this purchase during the promotion.
[angers] It is not the same mower as the Bunning model (DLM466PT2). ST has the older model on clearance with the $100 credit (Makita DLM464PT2). Bunnings also has the incorrect photo on their page if it is meant to the DLM466PT2.
https://makita.com.au/cordless/combos-kits/18v-single-tool-k…
[Funky777] Just got one from Bunnings in store and it is the newer model DLM466PT2.
[juzzo2118] 2nd this, and I went into a sydney tools during this week and they said they were all out of stock of the DLM464PT2 (castle hill) and that the closest one was in Minchinbury
[juzzo2118] Thats for NSW^
FWIW I went to bunnings and they were completely out of stock of the DLM464PT2. DLM466PT2 had plenty though it seems
[Cyprella] They claim to check but I don’t really think they do. It’s in the return policy that redemptions need to be returned at the same time.
Guess need someone to try it?
[BusMan247] Not being a prick? Acting like the people we don’t want in the country.
[Never pay retail] I don't understand the negative comments you're getting. 'Hacks' are posted all the time on here and no-one blinks an eye - in fact, people are often excited at the idea of 'taking from the big guys' like Bunnings, McDonald's, Amazon etc.
If the conditions of the deal allowed it to be returned and you keep the batteries, then it'd be fair play in my view.
[ATangk] Wheres the Makita redemption stacking to rival DeWalt?
[andymatter] Anyone with personal experience with this? I feel like it is going to weigh a tonne, mitigating one of the main advantages of electric mowers.
[Ah my lunch] I have a different model makita 2x18v. The weight balance is further rearward than a petrol mower, so it feels lighter when lifting the front to turn
[lomie] I lift this onto the back of my Prado to help someone else's lawn. It's manageable but just a bit awkward given the size and how far away the COG is from the body. It is a proper steel deck so low height is proper low. I also have a smaller Ryobi but it is so light, it kinda floats over the grass. So IMO, it is a like for like replacement with a petrol mower in terms of weight, just without the fumes.
Edit: I have the DLM464 and not the DLM466 in this deal.
[nfr] I have a Bosch Rotak Li that is also very light but it can cut very low, much lower than my Ozito Steel Deck, so the Ryobi probably has a design issue.
[Never pay retail] I also have a DLM464 and find it to be light enough to push. However it is still heavy if you plan to lift the whole thing. I find it cuts well if the grass is fully dry, but struggles with even slight damp/few.
[excite] looks like out of stock in Sydney Tools Vic
[Cludos] I got this mower kit below from Bunnings, came with blower and got 2 batteries from redemption, $650 in March.
Goes good have about 250m2 buffalo.
https://sydneytools.com.au/product/makita-dlm464pt2-36v-18v-…
[jackwangxp] So 2 battery or 4?
Description says including 2 battery and charger, and redemption for 2 more?
Wording is a little confusing.
[Elyxar] Mower is 36V and uses 2 18V batteries at a time to get the 36V. So comes with 2 and you get 2 more via redemption.
[87percent] Anyone compared this to the Ryobi 36v rlm36x46bl?
[yikes914] I have the older DLM464 model and it is a beast compared to my budget Ozito. I mow 350m2 every month at a friend's property and this thing with the mulching attachment just rips through it.
Also, got some Ozito to Makita battery adapters to make it easier and cheaper to run.
[MrBuu] Got a link on a recommended adapter per yours. I've had trouble in the past.
[Skad832] Are these any good compared to petrol powered 144cc Victa lawnmover?
[fantacular] Hard to find any reviews on this, can anyone locate one??
I have a sir grange lawn and need a beasty mower with plenty of height. I don’t mind weight and prefer the 2x18v models. Is this the machine for it??
[lankfert] Bought this mower for my folks as i own the older DLM464.
This feels much cheaper. There's no on switch, just pull the bar and go. No battery gauge, just a LED on the mower when it's getting low.
I haven't cut any lawn with it, but the specs say it has refined blade angle and chute. One of my gripes with the older 464 is that the catcher doesn't fill at the back and doesn't get full. The other (and main rason i got this for them) is the safety/brake bar is electric. It's light and easy to hold. My DLM464 has a velcro strap on it as it's too hard to hold even for me.
Despite the advantges, i'll keep my older 464. Had it for 5 years now with no problems.
[faricity] cheers was just looking at this for my parents last week. Original price was $849
